activeRuntimeEvidence.mismatch: The accepted exact Store hashes for headwear-1..4 are current independently accepted art, while the active equipped-avatar runtime still maps those IDs to legacy SVGs. This document is evidence/specification only and does not authorize runtime or canonical changes.

attachmentSurface.layerOrdering: headwearAvatarRuntime ensures the headwear layer is immediately before .head when both nodes exist

futureTryOnDerivativeContract.reason: Accepted card presentation JPGs are opaque square presentation art; direct avatar use would introduce card/background pixels rather than a clean wearable overlay.
futureTryOnDerivativeContract.identityRule: Any later avatar-safe derivative may isolate/reframe the accepted wearable geometry only; it may not redesign, retheme, rename or manufacture a new item identity.
fitRules: Preserve recognizable physical attachment/contact logic appropriate to the wearable.
Keep the silhouette legible at both 132x116 desktop and 118x104 mobile attachment surfaces.
Use the verified center-bottom attachment contract unless item-specific validated geometry later requires a documented offset.
Avoid accidental clipping or floating geometry; intentional silhouette protrusions must still preserve clear head contact.

itemAttachmentSpecs.name: Headband
itemAttachmentSpecs.contact: Forehead/temple band must visibly span and contact both sides rather than float above the head.

itemAttachmentSpecs.name: Cloud Clips
itemAttachmentSpecs.contact: Paired hair/temple clips must retain clip/contact logic; clouds must not read as unsupported floating symbols.

itemAttachmentSpecs.name: Pixel Cap
itemAttachmentSpecs.contact: Cap crown sits on the head top and brim reads forward; silhouette must remain readable at mobile scale.

itemAttachmentSpecs.name: Berry Bow
itemAttachmentSpecs.contact: Bow/clip knot mounts to the head/hair with attachment implied or visible; bow must not float independently.
